fact: The Partnership Compact of March 2023 says MINEDUC is using the GPE System Capacity Grant (US$1,177,715, part of a larger US$2.4 million grant, January 2023 to February 2024, UNICEF as grant agent) to operationalize a system for monitoring absenteeism, especially in public schools, through which teachers and head teachers can detect students at risk of dropping out.
title: Rwanda 2023-2027 Partnership Compact: Pursuing an Inclusive and Transformative Reform Agenda for Improved Inclusive Quality Teaching and Learning in Rwanda
